en: A colorized historic postcard view of a busy bridge over a river leading into a city square. The ornate iron bridge is crowded with pedestrians and an early electric tram. On the far side stand multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs, one bearing the sign 'CAFÉ MERAN'. There are lampposts and statues on the bridge and in the square, with trees and more buildings behind. A church tower with a clock rises in the background. The caption at the top reads 'Graz. Franz Karl-Brücke.'
